description: This file defines a React component for a text input field that supports both text and textarea modes, with validation logic, serialization/deserialization, and accompanying controller logic for form handling in a Keystone-like framework.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: React component rendering either a TextField or TextArea with validation, error messages, and change handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the text value based on length and regex constraints, returning an array of error messages.

methods.name: deserializeTextValue
methods.description: Converts a string or null into an InnerTextValue object.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Returns a controller object for handling text fields, including serialize, deserialize, validation, and filter logic.
